builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Briar: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A committed melee pursuer who converts bleed and bite damage into healing, with a scream as her principal control release. Measure bleed/bite healing and attacks during frenzy, then whether E releases control in time. A high damage ceiling cannot excuse uncontrollable target access or deaths. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
builds.summary: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Briar: Measure bleed/bite healing and attacks during frenzy, then whether E releases control in time. A high damage ceiling cannot excuse uncontrollable target access or deaths.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Fury. Do not treat mana regeneration as Fury recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Briar leaps to a unit and hits enemies with The Heel Wheel (of Pain), stunning them and breaking their Armor. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Fury. Do not treat mana regeneration as Fury recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

While in Blood Frenzy she gains [(0.55 / 0.65 / 0.75 / 0.85 / 0.95) × 100]% Attack Speed and [(0.24 / 0.33 / 0.42 / 0.51 / 0.6) × 100]% Move Speed, and her Attacks deal [(0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9 / 1) × AD] physical damage to enemies surrounding her target.

Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals [5 / 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 + (1.05) × AD] + [9 + (0.025) × AD[statFormula=2]]% missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for [(0.05) × Stat(12)] + [(0.24 / 0.28 / 0.32 / 0.36 / 0.4) × 100]% of the damage dealt.

Briar leaps to a target, Stunning it for [0.85] seconds, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.6) × AP + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and reducing [(0.1 / 0.125 / 0.15 / 0.175 / 0.2) × 100]% Armor and Magic Resist for [5] seconds.

Briar will stop prioritizing champions if she casts this Ability on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy.

Briar's Attacks and Abilities apply a bleed for [5] seconds, stacking up to [5] times. The bleed deals [(characterLevelInterpolation(2 → 10; raw flags preserved) + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (5)] to [(characterLevelInterpolation(2 → 10; raw flags preserved) + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((5) × (2))] physical damage based on stacks, and Heals Briar for [25]% of the pre-mitigation damage.

Briar gains up to [(0.4 + (0.00025) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (100)]% increased Healing based on her missing Health. She has no Base Health Regeneration and her Abilities cost [5]% current Health to cast.

Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (1.3) × AP] magic damage to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to Flee for [1.5] seconds. She then enters an empowered Blood Frenzy and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains [(0.2) × AD] Armor and Magic Resist, [(0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2) × 100]% Lifesteal, and an additional [(0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed.

Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining [35]% damage reduction and restoring [(0.1 / 0.115 / 0.13 / 0.145 / 0.16) × Stat(12)] Health over 1 second.

Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP] magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by [80]% for [0.5] seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing [140 / 215 / 290 / 365 / 440 + (2.4) × AD[statFormula=2] + (2.4) × AP] magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for [1.5] seconds.
